metadata.title: Beit Hob
metadata.description: Empowering youth through cultural, social, artistic, and sports activities.

brand.name: Beit Hob
brand.tagline: Empowering individuals through culture and professional growth

hero.title: Creating more of who you can become
hero.description: Beit Hob creates spaces for learning, exploration, and connection — so young people in Lebanon can discover, develop, and pursue more of what they are capable of becoming.
hero.imageAlt: Young people at a Beit Hob workshop

intro.heading: Life is not a fixed structure
intro.body1: We start out trying to find a place for ourselves, only to discover that life is not so much about finding yourself as it is about creating yourself. We are multidimensional beings, full of potential, living within a stream of possibilities.
intro.body2: Yet the possibilities we can imagine are often limited by what we have already seen, known, or experienced. There are talents we have not had the chance to discover, fields we have never encountered, and directions we have never considered.
intro.body3: Beit Hob exists to create more of those chances.

programs.heading: What We Do
programs.subheading: Three pillars, one mission: creating chances for people to grow.

art.title: Art & Culture
art.description: Workshops, performances, and cultural experiences that spark expression and creativity.

professional.title: Professional Development
professional.description: Skills, mentorship, and practical tools to help young people build their future.

sports.title: Sports & Community
sports.description: Sports, teamwork, and community initiatives that build resilience and belonging.

quote.text: Of all the things we can develop in this life, perhaps the greatest is ourselves.

closing.title: Be part of what comes next
closing.description: Whether you want to learn, contribute, or collaborate — there is a place for you at Beit Hob.

footer.tagline: Beit Hob is a non-profit creating spaces for learning, exploration, and connection — from art and culture to sports and professional growth.
